notes.title: 《DreamBreaker》Update announcement on August 25, 2025
notes.content: [p]Hello, players! Thank you very much for your recent feedback on 《DreamBreaker》. —— We are still constantly updating the game.[/p][p]Any comments can be posted in the official QQ group or in the comments section. Thank you all for your support![/p][p]The following are the changes in this version:[/p][h3][/h3][h3]Modify map scenes[/h3][p]Many previously flawed map scenes have been modified to make the overall picture cleaner and neater.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317137/60b652a9e3f20448a265170add0a6e76236c3e37.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Modify battle background[/h3][p]The AI-generated battle background images have been replaced, as they were inconsistent in style and varied in quality. A simplified parchment style consistent with the map has been adopted, eliminating clutter from the overall battle scene and allowing players to clearly see all battle-related information.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317137/a56e732437df98cfcac84787420d0d62d9aeb76d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Performance optimization[/h3][p]Added animation and highlighting to the character upgrade prompt arrow.[/p][p]Optimized animation performance when entering battle.[/p][p]Added color differentiation to the border of the BUFF prompt box. Now you can tell whether it belongs to Positive/Negative/Element from the border color of the BUFF.[/p][p]Modified the descriptions of multiple resonances to make them more accurate.[/p][p]Optimized loading interface[/p][p]Optimized battle Reward interface[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317137/c9736e7dffaab9d711cb5614ec592dc96f32ed8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Resolution optimization[/h3][p]The maximum supported resolution has been increased from the original 1920*1080 to 3840*2160.[/p][p][/p][h3]Balance adjustment[/h3][p]We noticed that many battles were too difficult, so we adjusted and lowered the difficulty of some battles.[/p][p]Including multiple scenarios such as the Assassin Trial, Mage Trial, and Tavern's request.[/p]
